1.title: GHSA-crj3-q72p-ggqm — @waline/client vulnerable to stored XSS through unsanitized comment edit previews
1.summary:
### Summary

`@waline/client` renders the comment editor's live preview with `marked` and no sanitizer (`utils/markdown.ts`), and the preview is injected with `v-html`.

When a comment is edited, the editor is seeded with the comment's raw, un-sanitized body (`orig`).

Only administrators and the comment owner can edit. So an administrator who clicks Edit on an attacker's comment renders that attacker's raw HTML in their own session: an unauthenticated commenter achieves privilege-escalation stored XSS against a moderator with a single Edit click.

1.summary:
### Impact

`verify_envelope_bsp()` derived its trust anchor from the message it was
verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted

There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning.

1.title: GHSA-jp3c-6v3g-mpxv — github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp permits denial of service through a malformed IPv4 payload length
1.summary: In github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/nclient4, BroadcastRawUDPConn.ReadFrom does not validate that the IPv4 payload length is sufficient to hold a UDP header before calculating the DHCP payload length. A frame with an IPv4 total-length field specifying fewer than eight payload bytes results in a negative DHCP length, causing a panic in buf.Consume due to a negative slice bound.

1.summary:
The MCP bridge shipping in ruflo/docker-compose.yml exposed POST /mcp with no authentication. The docker-compose defaults bound the bridge and MongoDB to all interfaces.
